entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I made my way to the stone arch and..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way to the stone arch and sat down next to my daughter.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm surprised you haven't died of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised you haven't died of boredom yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Got a cigarette?""
entries.dialogueText: "Got a cigarette?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm discussing the fate of the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm discussing the fate of the country. How could I be bored?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's only a matter of time.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's only a matter of time."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Is the Grand Wiseman Nurist?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is the Grand Wiseman Nurist?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lit two cigarettes and handed o..."
entries.dialogueText: She lit two cigarettes and handed one to me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The fate of the country depends on..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fate of the country depends on tax rates and trade agreements, I see. Wake me when there's a war."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If your uncle was any more pleased..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your uncle was any more pleased with the sound of his own voice, he'd be a parakeet."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Seriously, I hope you're faring we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seriously, I hope you're faring well thus far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you trust Hugo?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you trust Hugo?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you know about the Golden Guar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you know about the Golden Guard?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a lot to take in.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a lot to take in."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You're asking the wrong person. Do..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're asking the wrong person. Don't forget, he positively loathes me."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Of course, darling. They're a litt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, darling. They're a little unnerving at first, but that Titus fellow would take a bullet for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stormed off, leaving me to my o..."
entries.dialogueText: She stormed off, leaving me to my own thoughts. Before I knew it, it was time for the council meeting.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to see you outside of the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you outside of the council chambers. Do you have any questions about the past few meetings?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""With that said, he was nothing but..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, he was nothing but loyal to your father. And that loyalty extends to anyone with the last name Toras, personal squabbles aside."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Even more so for Vina, I imagine.""
entries.dialogueText: "Even more so for Vina, I imagine."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Now picture your daughter having t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now picture your daughter having to fill her head with that drivel. Aren't you glad you kept her off the Council?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm relieved to hear that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved to hear that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't be so sure, myself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be so sure, myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can tell she's struggling, but s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell she's struggling, but she'll learn."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know. Maybe it would have..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. Maybe it would have been a valuable experience."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bet you're wishing you'd never a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I bet you're wishing you'd never asked to come to my meetings, right?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What are you talking about? It's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you talking about? It's been fascinating!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To my left, I saw Vina reading a bo..."
entries.dialogueText: To my left, I saw Vina reading a book on a bench beneath a decorative stone arch. In the date palm grove to my right, I caught a glimpse of my mother.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, she's lucky not to have to de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, she's lucky not to have to deal with it all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry if Uncle Hugo made you feel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry if Uncle Hugo made you feel uncomfortable the other day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm starting to regret giving..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm starting to regret giving in to her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's that you've been reading?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's that you've been reading?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Let's hope it never comes to that...."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope it never comes to that. It'd be a waste of a spectacular torso."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're sitting on so much money. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're sitting on so much money. Why didn't Father do anything with it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Better his than mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "Better his than mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spectacular? I hadn't noticed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spectacular? I hadn't noticed."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He was paralyzed at the end. By th..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was paralyzed at the end. By the weight of all the decisions he had made, and the fear of making a faulty one."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Nearly losing you had a momentous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nearly losing you had a momentous effect on him. On us both."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bell chimed in the distance. It w..."
entries.dialogueText: A bell chimed in the distance. It was time for the meeting to begin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I *did* lose my wife. I managed to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I *did* lose my wife. I managed to keep myself together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can respect that. I haven't been..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can respect that. I haven't been the same since losing Lena."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And now I've got to pick up all of..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now I've got to pick up all of his slack."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's keeping up just fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's keeping up just fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen, I'll give the book back to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, I'll give the book back to you. But don't let anyone else catch you reading it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I snatched the book out of Vina's b..."
entries.dialogueText: I snatched the book out of Vina's bag.
entries.menuText: Take the book and look at it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I made my way to the palm grove and..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way to the palm grove and tapped my mother on the shoulder.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's okay. I know he means well.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's okay. I know he means well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hurriedly shoved the book she w..."
entries.dialogueText: She hurriedly shoved the book she was reading into her handbag. On the cover were the words "Ce Faximi" -- "What Are We To Do?" in Rizian.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh! Greetings, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh! Greetings, Father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Show me that book. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Show me that book. Now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sheepishly fished the book out..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sheepishly fished the book out of her bag and handed it to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a closer look at the cover...."
entries.dialogueText: I took a closer look at the cover. Beneath the title were the words, "A Collection of Proposals by L. Chavatangakwunua."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The uprising didn't succeed becaus..."
entries.dialogueText: "The uprising didn't succeed because the Rizian people knew what was good for them. A strong leader and strong laws."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No! You can't do that!""
entries.dialogueText: "No! You can't do that!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chava-what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Chava-what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This had better not be what I thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This had better not be what I think it is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bit her lip nervously."
entries.dialogueText: She bit her lip nervously.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It failed because it lacked cohesi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It failed because it lacked cohesion. Every faction was fighting for something different."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Look at what he writes here. True..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at what he writes here. True systemic change can only be accomplished with the wholehearted support of the working class."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Workers did join the protests. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Workers did join the protests. But yes, the initial spark came from naval officers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need to bother with this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to bother with this. You're a princess, not an intellectual."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enroll in etiquette classes. Learn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enroll in etiquette classes. Learn how to bake. The possibilities are endless."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You can't control what I read, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't control what I read, you know. I'm a grown woman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. But don't let anyone el..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. But don't let anyone else catch you reading it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would be easier if I knew whom..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be easier if I knew whom I could trust."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RemoveConversant("Estela Toras");

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's not as extreme as his later w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not as extreme as his later work. He wrote it right before changing his last name to Malenyev."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He changed it to Malenyev right af..."
entries.dialogueText: "He changed it to Malenyev right after this was published."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is dangerous propaganda, Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is dangerous propaganda, Vina. Don't you realize Malenyev and his followers hate people like you and me?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Isn't that why it's important to k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't that why it's important to know how they think?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know, I've always been curious..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, I've always been curious about Malenyevism. Do you think it's compatible with monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Do you think that's why the uprisi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think that's why the uprising in Rizia failed? Because workers weren't the ones leading the charge?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You wouldn't allow me onto the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't allow me onto the council. There are only so many balls I can attend. What else am I supposed to do?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Endlessly dull, you mean. Will you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Endlessly dull, you mean. Will you please give me my book back?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina gave me a conspiratorial nod."
entries.dialogueText: Vina gave me a conspiratorial nod.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I won't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That name sounds familiar.""
entries.dialogueText: "That name sounds familiar."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This was one of his first tracts...."
entries.dialogueText: "This was one of his first tracts. He wrote it right before changing his name to Malenyev."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And? Are you learning anything int..."
entries.dialogueText: "And? Are you learning anything interesting?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""They thought that was what they wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "They thought that was what they wanted. Because nobody bothered to teach them otherwise."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And aristocrats working for their..."
entries.dialogueText: "And aristocrats working for their own gain, right? Like your kidnappers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is no way for a Toras to be c..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is no way for a Toras to be carrying on. I'm taking this book away from you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew you'd learn more off the co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew you'd learn more off the council than on it. Keep it up."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Chin up, now. I'll see you at supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chin up, now. I'll see you at supper."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother raised her parasol and st..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother raised her parasol and strode away.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina += 1

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina stared at me in disbelief for..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina stared at me in disbelief for a moment.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina -= 1

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I will. Enjoy the boring meetings.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Enjoy the boring meetings."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took the book and walked away,..."
entries.dialogueText: She took the book and walked away, leaving me to my own thoughts. Before I knew it, it was time for the council meeting.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RemoveConversant("Vina Toras");

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where did you find this?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where did you find this?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It was just lying around in the li..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was just lying around in the library. One of his supporters must have had it translated into Rizian."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Of course, he wrote this right bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, he wrote this right before he changed his name to Malenyev."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Malenyev? What happened to Queen L..."
entries.dialogueText: "Malenyev? What happened to Queen Lyza?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've read all her writings already..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've read all her writings already. And this one applies to our modern era far more."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Malenyevist -= 1

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina stared at me in disbelief for..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina stared at me in disbelief for a second, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Find another use of your time.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Find another use of your time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's overwhelming at times. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's overwhelming at times. But I trust the council to help me decide."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lowered the black lace parasol..."
entries.dialogueText: She lowered the black lace parasol she was holding and linked her arm through mine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She reached into her handbag and pu..."
entries.dialogueText: She reached into her handbag and pulled out a slim paperback. On its cover were the words "Ce Faximi", or "What Are We To Do?" in Rizian.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I have plenty. But I'll figure the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have plenty. But I'll figure them out on my own time."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All of this council stuff is old h..."
entries.dialogueText: "All of this council stuff is old hat for you, isn't it? You've even served with some of the same people before."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""One more thing, darling...""
entries.dialogueText: "One more thing, darling..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a closer look at the cover...."
entries.dialogueText: I took a closer look at the cover. Beneath the title were the words, "A Collection of Proposals by L. Chavatangakwunua."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I found this in Vina's room after..."
entries.dialogueText: "I found this in Vina's room after she went to lunch. Her way of rebelling against you for not letting her on the council, I assume."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is this what I think it is?.""
entries.dialogueText: "Is this what I think it is?."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She was too quiet. I worried she w..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was too quiet. I worried she was up to something."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm the king. Every decision I mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm the king. Every decision I make is the right decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chava-what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Chava-what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What were you doing snooping aroun..."
entries.dialogueText: "What were you doing snooping around my daughter's room?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's been reading this? Interesti..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's been reading this? Interesting."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I remember hearing that name a lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember hearing that name a long time ago. Before he changed it to Malenyev."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh! Hello, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh! Hello, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This must be overwhelming for you..."
entries.dialogueText: "This must be overwhelming for you as well. So many decisions to make."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A long time ago. Frankly, they sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "A long time ago. Frankly, they should have retired by now."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Any good monarch listens to the wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any good monarch listens to the will of the public. Queen Lyza always said that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Queen Lyza wasn't a saint. She had..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Lyza wasn't a saint. She had her flaws."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic += 1

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""By the time she was my age, she'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the time she was my age, she'd already been queen for a year. Imagine!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, it's easy enough. I'm the kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's easy enough. I'm the king. What I say goes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you worry about me. Focus on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you worry about me. Focus on keeping your own head above water."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. But it's still an inspirin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But it's still an inspiring legacy to live up to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's different now that I'm the on..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's different now that I'm the one in charge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course I will. They're the best..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I will. They're the best hope we have for giving Rizians an actual voice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wise words from a wise woman.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wise words from a wise woman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was naive back then. Now I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was naive back then. Now I don't know whom I can trust."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Lyza acted, too.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lyza acted, too."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You can always trust me, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can always trust me, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ms. Werner and Mr. Esquibel may be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner and Mr. Esquibel may be old, but what they were saying made a lot of sense to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A good monarch listens. A great mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A good monarch listens. A great monarch acts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if the will of the public is f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if the will of the public is for there to be no monarch at all? What then?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you rule as well as she did, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you rule as well as she did, that won't ever become a problem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lead the way, Your Highness.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lead the way, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I will. I've been taking notes.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. I've been taking notes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not against the opposition bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not against the opposition because of House Sazon. I'm against it because it's the opposition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll take their opinions into cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take their opinions into consideration. But I'm the one with the final say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I might, but I don't want anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might, but I don't want anything to do with your friend Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Why do you have it out for House S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you have it out for House Sazon? Just because one duke plotted against the king doesn't mean the whole family is evil."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucas put a taint on his entire ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucas put a taint on his entire house. I won't discuss this further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not all of the Sazons. Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not all of the Sazons. Manus in particular strikes me as suspicious."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Suspicious? He wants to work with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suspicious? He wants to work with you. Why not at least hear what he has to say?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh. Right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Right."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Okay, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What do you think of the House of..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think of the House of Delegates? Will you go talk to them?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only reason I would do that is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only reason I would do that is to find out the opposition's weaknesses."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic -= 1

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Sazons have never truly been a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons have never truly been a royal house. Their ancestor had no claim to the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A clock chimed in the distance. It..."
entries.dialogueText: A clock chimed in the distance. It was time for the meeting.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't imagine how it feels to ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't imagine how it feels to hold all that power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough chit-chat. Let's go.""
entries.dialogueText: "Enough chit-chat. Let's go."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The royal heir doesn't always have..."
entries.dialogueText: "The royal heir doesn't always have to be the king's son. Sometimes there are special circumstances."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Um... not really. A society ruled..."
entries.dialogueText: "Um... not really. A society ruled by a king is the embodiment of everything Malenyevists hate."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But it's useful to know how they t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it's useful to know how they think, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I mean... of course it's all rubbi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean... of course it's all rubbish. But it does make one think."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The student and workers' movement..."
entries.dialogueText: "The student and workers' movement was more aligned with Malenyevism, but the nobles who rebelled were in favor of Arcasian democracy."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic -= 1

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Malenyevist -= 1

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And reading Malenyevist tracts is..."
entries.dialogueText: "And reading Malenyevist tracts is definitely 'something'."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's an underreaction, wouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's an underreaction, wouldn't you say? Malenyevist tracts belong in an incinerator, not your daughter's bedroom."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I can see why he changed it to 'Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can see why he changed it to 'Malenyev', That's one unholy mass of letters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There were Malenyevists involved i..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were Malenyevists involved in the '26 uprising, weren't there? It could be useful to learn how the enemy thinks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right, Mother. I'm sure it'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Mother. I'm sure it's pure garbage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's a smart girl. She wouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's a smart girl. She wouldn't be reading this if there weren't value in it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's what I'm worried about, dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I'm worried about, dear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. Well, better this than Arca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Well, better this than Arcasian garbage."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Malenyevist += 1

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The man had some good ideas. Maybe..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man had some good ideas. Maybe his vision of a more egalitarian society isn't entirely incompatible with monarchy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My dear, I'm no scholar, but I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear, I'm no scholar, but I do know there's a direct correlation between this fellow's line of thinking and royal beheadings."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The workers and students were insp..."
entries.dialogueText: "The workers and students were inspired by Malenyevism. The nobles who got involved were pushing for Arcasian-style democracy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm no scholar myself. But I do kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm no scholar myself. But I do know the former leads to more royal beheadings than the latter."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's more than that, dear. Garbage..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's more than that, dear. Garbage won't cut off your head in the middle of the night."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""So what should I do with the book?""
entries.dialogueText: "So what should I do with the book?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My dear, I'm no scholar, but I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear, I'm no scholar, but I do know there's a direct correlation between this fellow's line of thinking and royal beheadings."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""They're like cannons at that age...."
entries.dialogueText: "They're like cannons at that age. You've got to mind the direction they're pointed in, or there'll be hell to pay when they go off."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Very well. But I do suggest having..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. But I do suggest having a chat with her about this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put the book back in her purse."
entries.dialogueText: She put the book back in her purse.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina_TookBookAway = true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Put it back where you found it. Vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Put it back where you found it. Vina's allowed to read what she wants in her free time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is dangerous propaganda. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is dangerous propaganda. You were right to bring it to my attention."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I try to stay out of ideological d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I try to stay out of ideological debates. But I do know there's a direct correlation between this line of thinking and royal beheadings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give it to me. Vina shouldn't be e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give it to me. Vina shouldn't be exposed to such ideas."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Good thinking, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good thinking, Romus."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title:
RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina_TookBookAway = true;
RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina -= 1

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She handed the book to me."
entries.dialogueText: She handed the book to me.
